title: Ranks & promotions
error: Unable to complete this action. Refresh to check the current records before retrying.

noAccess: You do not have permission to view ranks.
noSystems: Create a rank system or apply a content pack to get started.
applyPack: Apply a content pack JSON file
packHelp: Use a versioned content pack (up to 1 MB). Reapplying restores missing records and preserves your edits.
name: Name
criteriaHelp: Leave a target blank to omit that criterion. Targets apply to the selected rank and each of its sub-ranks.
noPrograms: No active programs in this rank system
noRanks: No ranks in this rank system
namesUnavailable: Member names are unavailable. Member IDs are shown until the roster loads.
bulkHelp: Each member's promotion is saved separately. If a batch stops, refresh and review history before retrying.
manualHelp: Review the criteria, then record the coach's decision. A promotion resets attendance and time counters.
loadFailed: Ranks couldn't be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
noSystemsReadOnly: An owner or admin can set up rank systems in Configure ranks.
noRanksHelp: Use Add rank to create the first rank in this system.
readyHelp: Members who meet the criteria for the selected rank. Select the ones the coaches have approved, then promote them together.
noEligibleReady: Nobody meets the criteria yet. Turn off "Show ready members only" to see everyone's progress.
noEligibleAll: Nobody is working toward this rank in this program.
